dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Both repeatable flags parse and no-field behavior remains intact, but mutually exclusive flags are accepted and formatted output silently ignores selected columns.
evidence: product.diff: adds StringArrayVar flags and repeated-field help example
product.diff: selectedFields processes names and IDs sequentially with no conflict check
product.diff: exporter.Write executes without using resolved fields

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive matching, canonical headers, and candidate-bearing errors are complete. Ambiguity is detected, but its candidate IDs retain input/API order rather than being explicitly sorted.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: unknown-name and unknown-ID candidates are sorted
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous IDs are appended without sorting
product.diff: headers use field.Name()

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The initial field definitions returned by the item query are reused, but requested fields beyond the first field page are never fetched.
evidence: product.diff: runList resolves project.Fields.Nodes directly
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems requests firstFields=LimitMax and paginates only items
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectFields contains the available field-pagination path, which the candidate does not call

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value variants are rendered, and unknown/missing values produce empty strings. Multiline normalization is not implemented in the visible rendering path.
evidence: product.diff: fieldValueDisplay covers date, iteration, labels, number, select, text, milestone, PR, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff: projectFieldValue returns an empty string when no matching field ID exists
product.diff: rendering returns raw strings; no carriage-return/newline normalization is present
tests.log: go test ./pkg/cmd/project/item-list ./pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries exited 0

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Resolved fields are appended to headers and each row looks up every requested value by field node ID, adding an empty cell when absent; the existing command path still calls the table renderer.
evidence: product.diff: printResults appends field.Name() headers in selected order
product.diff: each row calls projectFieldValue(..., field.ID()) before EndRow
product.diff: runList retains owner/project/item retrieval then calls printResults

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Lookup errors occur before rendering and the patch uses established query types, but invalid combined selection is accepted and can render duplicate/misleading columns instead of failing.
evidence: product.diff: selectedFields errors return before exporter or printResults
product.diff: no validation rejects simultaneous --field and --field-id
product.diff: focused changes are confined to item-list and its tests

criticalGaps: --field and --field-id are not mutually exclusive, and field selection is not rejected with formatted/JSON output.
Field definitions are limited to the first page; requested fields on later pages cannot resolve.
Rendered values are not visibly normalized to remove carriage returns and replace newlines.
